title: Atrial fibrillation: type, history and anticoagulation
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's atrial fibrillation and related long-term drug therapy.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for management of heart rhythm.

HPI
The patient is an 89-year-old woman who presents today for a routine follow-up of her permanent atrial fibrillation. She reports feeling well overall and denies any new palpitations, lightheadedness, or shortness of breath. She is currently managed with a rate-control strategy and reports good compliance with her prescribed medications. She currently does not require any anticoagulant medications due to her low risk profile.

Medication List
Metoprolol 25mg daily.

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. Her blood pressure is 128/78 mmHg and heart rate is 72 beats per minute. She appears in no acute distress. Heart sounds are regular with a rate of 72 bpm. No murmurs are noted. Lungs are clear to auscultation.

Assessment
1. Permanent atrial fibrillation: The patient is stable on her current rate-control regimen.

Plan
We will continue the current dosage of Metoprolol for her atrial fibrillation. She will follow up in six months for a routine evaluation.

Electronically signed, P. O'Brien, MD, 05/14/2026

distractors.why: Permanent has its own code; I48.20 is chronic AF, unspecified.
